summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Deal Pipeline Kanban/List view toggle feature. Backend APIs pass all 15 tests. Frontend UI is fully functional after fixing the dialog open bug. All requested features are working correctly.
passed_tests: Deals page loads at /deals with default Kanban view
View toggle shows Kanban and List buttons
Clicking List button switches to list/table view
Clicking Kanban button switches back to kanban view
Kanban view shows 5 columns: Leads, Qualified, Proposal, Negotiation, Closed Won
Kanban cards have drag handles and can be dragged between columns
List view shows sortable table with columns: Deal, Stage, Value, Contact, Property, Created
Clicking a column header sorts by that column (asc/desc toggle with amber arrow indicator)
List view rows have drag handles for reordering
Stage dropdown in list view allows changing deal stage inline
Edit button on deal opens edit modal with pre-filled data
Stats summary cards show count and value per stage
New Deal button creates a deal with all fields
Backend API: GET /api/deals returns deals list
Backend API: POST /api/deals creates new deal
Backend API: GET /api/deals/{id} returns single deal
Backend API: PATCH /api/deals/{id}/stage updates deal stage
Backend API: PUT /api/deals/{id} updates full deal
Backend API: DELETE /api/deals/{id} deletes deal
Backend API: All 5 stages (lead, qualified, proposal, negotiation, closed) are valid

bugs_fixed.issue: Dialog not opening when clicking 'New Deal' button - handleDialogClose function only handled close state, not open state
bugs_fixed.fix: Updated handleDialogClose to accept 'open' parameter and properly handle both open (true) and close (false) states

seed_data_creation: 7 deals exist in database across different stages (Qualified: 2, Proposal: 3, Negotiation: 2)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deal Pipeline page is fully functional with Kanban and List view toggle. The @dnd-kit library is used for drag-and-drop in both views. Kanban view uses framer-motion for animations. List view has sortable headers with amber arrow indicators. Stage dropdown in list view allows inline stage changes. The dialog bug was fixed - handleDialogClose now properly handles both open and close states.

features_verified.list_view: Working - sortable table with inline stage dropdown
features_verified.view_toggle: Working - switches between Kanban and List views
features_verified.create_deal: Working - dialog opens with all fields
features_verified.edit_deal: Working - dialog opens with pre-filled data
features_verified.stage_change: Working - both via drag-drop and dropdown
features_verified.sorting: Working - click headers to sort asc/desc
features_verified.stats_cards: Working - shows count and value per stage
